# YT SEO Architect
> AI-powered YouTube SEO platform — 50+ free tools for keyword research, tag generation, title optimization, channel audit, and more.
> Site: https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app
> Updated: 2026-08-03

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/): AI YouTube SEO toolkit: keyword research, script &amp; tag generator, metadata audit, thumbnail analyzer. 100% Free &amp; Unlimited — no credits, no subscription, no catch.
- [Dashboard](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/dashboard): Full YouTube SEO dashboard with channel connect, AI coach, keyword research, channel audit
- [Tools](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/tools/): 95 free interactive YouTube SEO tools: tag generator, title scorer, keyword research, description writer, SEO auditor, CTR calculator, shadow ban detector, content planner, and more. No login required, works offline.
- [About](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/about): About YT SEO Architect and its creator
- [Privacy Policy](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of Service](https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/terms-of-service)
